column1: # d197_rule.tsv — D197's DECISION RULE for the mfcard window, DECLARED BEFORE ANY NUMBER EXISTS (review 2026-11-15 r5
# memfn-mfindcomb FIDELITY-4, as ruled; lane mcfixa). D197: the fused inline one-member finder is an unpicked
# measuring instrument; the timing is ONE-SIDED: a fused LOSS to libc memchr settles span_pick row 1 against the
# finder, a fused WIN triggers building the ruled split shape under its own owner go (then a re-measure).
# Read by d197_rule.py (`rule RUNDIR AVX2RUNDIR`, `drill`). Every table is FIRST MATCH, top to bottom; the `when`
# words are the named predicates d197_rule.py defines (WHEN, one line each), nothing else.
# Units: est.py's, a find_hit@6 row's x_l = its per-HIT cost (cell minus its own miss-only base, over the planted
# hits E) in ppm of the window's unit W, per launch l (7 launches).
#   gain_l  = x_l(libc) - x_l(fused), the SAME job, launch and cell (positive: the fused form is cheaper per hit)
#   gain    = med over the 7 launches of gain_l
#   floor   = aa(libc) + aa(fused), each row's paired A/A (est.py's `aa`: med_l |x_l(twin) - x_l(arm)|)
#   trimmed = the 7 gain_l less the one farthest from their median (est.py's trim)
# NOTE (EMITTED-2): a mfind-swar (8-byte SWAR) row against libc measures SEARCH WIDTH, not fusion; it is reported by
# est.py as any row and never decides. NOTE (EMITTED-1): the timing sees one site; the emitted size (the lever
# text 2.9x-6x fn-memchr's body) is reported beside it, never folded into the verdict.
